plongee.title: Open Water
plongee.narrator: Leaving the wreck means facing the scale of the world again — vertical, with no landmarks.
plongee.text:
You dive away from the Derelicta.

Above: nothing but black. Below: the **orange glow**, heading **214°**.

Your HUD:

**620 m remaining · depth 190 m · lamp 26%**

Then the figure **blinks**: **24% · 27% · —% · 26%**. You stare at the display. It returns to **26%**.

**Cables** appear in your beam — old, corroded, fixed to an underwater cliff that drops straight into the abyss.

An abandoned mining colony. Or a route someone left for those who descend.

choices.text: Grab the first cable and descend fast
Scan the cliff — find the safest route

falaise.title: The Cliff
falaise.narrator: A vertical wall underwater never shows all of its top. Nor all of its bottom.
falaise.text:
You descend along the cables.

The rock is smooth, almost polished — not natural. Parallel **drill marks**, ancient.

At **240 m**, your HUD blinks once:

**WARNING — HEADING INVERTED**

Then returns to normal. You **think**.

The orange glow sometimes seems **above** you. Sometimes below. The **214° heading** wavers on your HUD. Narhex plays with verticality.

choices.text: Count your fin strokes — orient yourself

vertige.title: Lost Bearings
vertige.narrator: When you no longer know if you're rising, every metre descended feels like betrayal.
vertige.text:
Your suit's built-in sonar activates — Fableris relic, emergency mode.

**Ping.** Target: **behind you**, 40 m away.

You turn. Nothing in the lamp beam.

**Ping.** Target: **above**, 10 m away.

You look up. Black.

The radio crackles:

*« —{{player}}… sonar lies… the glow is down… — »*

Static.

Your lamp **flickers** — once, twice.

choices.text: Wait for the lamp to stabilise

lampe.title: The Failing Lamp
lampe.narrator: Without light, the cliff has no top or bottom. Only void on both sides.
lampe.text:
Third flicker.

**Off.**

Battery: **22%** displayed — then zero for a second. Bug. Failure. Fear.

In total darkness, the cable in your hand **vibrates** — faintly, steadily. Like a distant engine. Like a **call** downward.

And somewhere, very close, a rush of water that **isn't** yours.

choices.text: 🔦 Tap the lamp — force the beam
🫧 Let go of the light — follow the cable's vibration

audace_fosse.title: Edge of the Pit
audace_fosse.narrator: Lighting an abyss sometimes gives it a mouth.
audace_fosse.text:
You hit the casing. The lamp returns — trembling beam, **22%** displayed.

It sweeps the void.

A **mass** — wider than the Derelicta, slower than your pulse — fills the cone for a fraction of a second. Black on black. You **look away**, a reflex.

You **point the lamp** back at the pit.

**Nothing.** No wall. No cliff anymore. The cable continues into the black.

Identical water. As if you had imagined it.

Your HUD alone displays a line that wasn't there:

**DISTANCE: 0 m**

Then erases it. **620 m remaining** returns.

The radio: *« —Go down. Now. — »*

choices.text: Slide down the cable into the pit

lucidite_cable.title: The Pulling Line
lucidite_cable.narrator: When light lies, touch becomes cartography.
lucidite_cable.text:
You close your eyes — useless underwater, but the gesture **helps**.

Your hand on the cable: rising vibration, steady. Not an engine. A **rhythm** — three short, one long. Fableris signal. **Descend.** Not a trap: a **direction**.

You follow without the lamp. Ten metres. Twenty.

When you finally switch on again: **24%** — saved in the dark.

An **alcove** carved in the rock. A lair. Not an open maw.

choices.text: Reach the alcove — catch your breath

replat.title: The Shelf
replat.narrator: A plateau underwater is a rare permission to breathe — if you dare.
replat.text:
You reach a terrace — rail remnants, twisted posts, a **pumpkin symbol** carved in the rock, half erased.

The HUD finally stabilises:

**450 m remaining · depth 350 m · heading 214°**

The orange glow is **below**. This time, you're sure.

Your lamp: **19%** — display **jumping** for a second to **21%**, then back.

In the distance, a steady **ping** — regular, mechanical. A station. The next waypoint.

choices.text: Note the coordinates and prepare for what's next

fin_descente.title: Still Lower
fin_descente.narrator: On Narhex, every waypoint gained is a promise — not a victory.
fin_descente.text:
You leave the terrace.

The cliff continues below — but you know how to read the lie now. Sonar. Light. Verticality.

**450 metres** still to go. The portal pulses somewhere beneath your feet.

Your lamp: **18%**. The station ping waits.

**END EPISODE 3 — Descent**

*Episode 4: Sonar — coming soon*
